assertions.assertion: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and a sensation of irregular heartbeat
Patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to capture continuous rhythm data
Monitoring is intended to correlate symptoms with potential cardiac events over an extended monitoring period
The service addresses the clinical need to link reported symptoms of irregular heartbeat with cardiac events
The denial stated that documentation did not establish the requirement for continuous ambulatory monitoring
